SECRET

Your Ref: P.47467/1.
Our Ref: PF.66074/F3m.

10th September, 1945.

Dear Governor,

Thank you very much for letting me see the letter to OLDAG, which I now return. As far as we are concerned it can be given to the prisoner.

Yours sincerely,

G.R. Mitchell.

The Governor,
H.M. Prison,
BRIXTON.

Copy of letter p.a.d in:-
PF.217,740(LEAN)
